A '''birthmark''' was a natural blemish or mark on a being's skin. [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] were three [[Species/Legends|species]] capable of exhibiting birthmarks.
